anatomical_axes: World-space torso-following axes derived from rest torso up plus the preview's audited front-facing -Y direction; all vectors are measured from the shoulder and normalized by each character's own rest arm length.

luigi_armature_luigirun.description: Rotate only the left shoulder root around anatomical torso-up when the V3 wrist or elbow is farther backward than Luigi's corresponding normalized torso-relative reach. Preserve forward reach, elbow bend, and all child local channels.

luigi_armature_luigijump.description: Correct only left glove-root orientation using rest-relative hand-to-forearm orientation in the anatomical body frame. Keep forearm and wrist position trajectory fixed.

luigi_armature_swimbreast.description: At frame 5, move the left elbow's torso-relative lateral/forward direction toward Luigi using shoulder yaw only. During frames 11-14, rotate the two Waluigi forearm branches together toward Luigi's anatomical forearm direction while keeping the elbow pivot fixed.
